'''Mike Lane''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Montreal DPC]] on 18 August 2001 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Dagobah test to 5]], according to Yannick Lapointe's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2871">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-20-dpc-montreal-sex-drug-and-peel-pubd2871/ dpc-montreal-sex-drug-and-peel-pub], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 20 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-20-dpc-montreal-sex-drug-and-peel-pubd2871/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
